newsitem.title: USA: U.S. adj retail sales off 0.5 pct in Nov - Redbook.
newsitem.headline: U.S. adj retail sales off 0.5 pct in Nov - Redbook.

text.p: U.S. seasonally adjusted retail sales fell 0.5 percent in the first two weeks of fiscal November versus October, according to the Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc Redbook retail sales index.

Chain and discount stores "had expected their reported sales growth to slow from the first week due to technical factors like mismatched promotion schedules and the bi-monthly payroll cycle," the report said.
"Apparel continued to lead across the board at department stores and chains," it said. "Discounters said their leading items were smaller-ticket seasonal home furnishings."

The index rose 5.3 percent compared to the same month a year ago, the report said. Adjusted retail sales also rose 4.2 percent in the week ended November 16, compared with the same week a year ago, said the report.
